policy: same institution, exact cosine, nearest five, then frozen threshold; closed cases included
label_provenance: Authored synthetic scenario labels; independent human review pending.

metric_definitions.pairwise_threshold_rule: Review-worthy (same_incident OR related_issue) versus unrelated on labelled eligible pairs; not three-class classification or retrieval precision.
metric_definitions.same_incident_recall_at_5: Returned explicitly relevant same-incident pairs after nearest-five and threshold / all eligible relevant pairs; unavailable vectors count as misses.
metric_definitions.candidate_recall: Relevant pairs in nearest five before threshold / eligible relevant pairs.
metric_definitions.precision: Review-worthy / judged returned suggestions. Overall precision unavailable if any suggestion is unjudged; missing labels never become negatives.
metric_definitions.coverage: Queries with reference candidates or returned suggestions / eligible queries. Judgment coverage = judged / all returned suggestions.

eligibility_rules: Family-disjoint calibration/test; duplicate IDs and conflicting labels rejected.
Repeated normalized exact text across partitions excluded from test; near-duplicate leakage not independently audited.
All declared query IDs excluded from reference pools; no reliance on ID suffixes.
References share query institution and test partition; explicit same-incident labels define relevance.
No threshold selection or model activation; calibration metrics also use the frozen production threshold.
limitations: Synthetic regression only; not independently reviewed AICTE accuracy.
Sparse judgments cannot establish overall suggestion precision.
In-memory exact cosine timing is not PostgreSQL latency or end-to-end queue performance.
Evaluation breaks equal-score ties by ID; live SQL does not guarantee a tie order.
